commands.cmd:
V="$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/tools/promotion-gate-20260922/.venv"
sync=$(timeout 60 uv pip sync --dry-run --offline --python "$V/bin/python3" blueprints/us-equities/data/requirements.lock 2>&1) || { echo "PANDERA_INSTALL_FAIL: uv pip sync --dry-run failed"; printf '%s\n' "$sync" | tail -5; exit 1; }
pv=$("$V/bin/python3" -s -c "import importlib.metadata as m; print(m.version('pandera'))") || { echo "PANDERA_INSTALL_FAIL: pandera not importable metadata"; exit 1; }
tag=$(timeout 30 git ls-remote https://github.com/unionai-oss/pandera 'refs/tags/v0.33.1' 'refs/tags/v0.33.1^{}' | awk '{print $1}' | tail -1)
python3 - "$sync" "$pv" "$tag" <<'PY'
import glob, json, re, sys
sync, pv, tag = sys.argv[1:4]
pins = sorted({w['pin'] for f in glob.glob('catalogs/landscape/*.json') for l in json.load(open(f)).get('layers', []) for w in (l.get('winners') or []) if w.get('component_id') == 'data-pandera'})
commits = {c for p in pins for c in re.findall(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', p)}
lock = open('blueprints/us-equities/data/requirements.lock').read()
locked = re.findall(r'^pandera==(\S+)', lock, re.M)
unchanged = 'Would make no changes' in sync
ok = len(commits) == 1 and tag in commits and pv == '0.33.1' and locked == ['0.33.1'] and unchanged
print('PANDERA_INSTALL_' + ('OK' if ok else 'FAIL'), '| winner pin', pins, '| upstream tag v0.33.1 ->', tag, '| promotion-gate venv pandera', pv, '| requirements.lock pandera', locked, '| uv pip sync --dry-run --offline against the hash-pinned lock:', sync.strip().splitlines()[-1])
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY

commands.cmd:
V="$HOME/.local/share/codex-ecosystem/tools/promotion-gate-20260922/.venv"
PIN=62f55e2dccf0a199cfe4d6ce3eda0c1d29e2e4e6
FILES="tests/pandas/test_schemas.py tests/pandas/test_checks.py tests/pandas/test_checks_builtin.py tests/pandas/test_schema_components.py tests/pandas/test_errors.py tests/pandas/test_model.py"
D=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1
trap 'rm -rf "$D"' EXIT
timeout 120 git clone -q --depth 1 --branch v0.33.1 https://github.com/unionai-oss/pandera "$D/src" > "$D/clone.log" 2>&1 || { echo "PANDERA_UPSTREAM_TESTS_FAIL: clone of v0.33.1 failed"; exit 1; }
head=$(git -C "$D/src" rev-parse HEAD)
[ "$head" = "$PIN" ] || { echo "PANDERA_UPSTREAM_TESTS_FAIL: v0.33.1 checkout $head is not the winner pin commit"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p "$D/run" && cp -a "$D/src/tests" "$D/src/pyproject.toml" "$D/run/" || exit 1
cd "$D/run" || exit 1
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 timeout 300 uv run -q --no-project --python "$V/bin/python3" --with pytest==9.1.1 --with hypothesis==6.168.1 -- python -c "import pandera, pytest, hypothesis; print(pandera.__file__); print(pandera.__version__, pytest.__version__, hypothesis.__version__)" > "$D/where.txt" 2>&1 || { echo "PANDERA_UPSTREAM_TESTS_FAIL: test environment did not start"; cat "$D/where.txt"; exit 1; }
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 timeout 900 uv run -q --no-project --python "$V/bin/python3" --with pytest==9.1.1 --with hypothesis==6.168.1 -- python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider $FILES > "$D/pytest.log" 2>&1
rc=$?
python3 - "$D" "$rc" "$V" "$head" "$FILES" <<'PY'
import re, sys
d, rc, venv, head, files = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3], sys.argv[4], sys.argv[5].split()
where = open(d + '/where.txt').read().split('\n')
log = open(d + '/pytest.log').read()
summary = [line for line in log.splitlines() if re.match(r'^=+ .* in [0-9.]+s', line)]
counts = {k: int(n) for n, k in re.findall(r'(\d+) (passed|failed|errors?|skipped|xfailed|xpassed|deselected)', summary[-1] if summary else '')}
config = [line.replace(d, '<tmp>') for line in log.splitlines() if line.startswith(('platform ', 'configfile:', 'collected '))]
from_venv = where[0].startswith(venv + '/lib/') and '/site-packages/pandera/' in where[0]
ok = rc == 0 and bool(summary) and counts.get('passed', 0) > 0 and counts.get('failed', 0) == 0 and counts.get('error', 0) == 0 and counts.get('errors', 0) == 0 and from_venv and where[1].split()[0] == '0.33.1'
print('PANDERA_UPSTREAM_TESTS_' + ('OK' if ok else 'FAIL'), '| pytest exit', rc, '|', summary[-1].strip('= ') if summary else 'no summary', '| unionai-oss/pandera v0.33.1 checkout', head, '| pandera imported from the promotion-gate venv:', from_venv)
print('upstream files run unchanged:', ' '.join(files), '|', ' | '.join(config), '| pandera/pytest/hypothesis', where[1])
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY
